mathematical_explanation: Gaussian Naive Bayes is mathematically invariant to linear scaling (StandardScaler). However, scikit-learn adds an absolute variance floor epsilon = var_smoothing * max(variance). On unscaled network traffic, Flow Bytes/s has variance ~10^16, so epsilon = 10^7, which gets added to low-variance features like ACK Flag Count (variance ~0.1), completely destroying their separability. When var_smoothing=0 or when features are standardized, the variance floor does not distort features, proving the gap is an artifact of scikit-learn's global var_smoothing parameter.
